q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a roller chain?
title: Roller chain carbon footprint per kg
short: Chains are mostly steel: multiply the steel strip and wire used per kg of chain by the supplier's figure, then add stamping, heat treatment, assembly and finishing energy per kg made.
audience: Roller chain makers for bicycles, two-wheelers and industry

ul: Steel wire for pins, bushes and rollers.
Stamping link plates and making pins, bushes and rollers.

p: Report per kg, or per metre by chain size.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 52,850 / 100,000 = 0.528 kg CO2 per kg
Add steel strip and wire for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
